mapper.sql: id, ticket_no, channel_id, dept_id, biz_dept_id, category_id, status, urgency, title, content, location, contact_name, contact_phone, image_urls, access_token_hash, assignee_id, assignee_name, work_record_id, submit_ip, submit_ua, due_time, accept_time, done_time, close_time, rating, rating_comment, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_ticket ( ticket_no, channel_id, dept_id, biz_dept_id, category_id, status, urgency, title, content, location, contact_name, contact_phone, image_urls, access_token_hash, submit_ip, submit_ua, due_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{ticketNo}, #{channelId}, #{deptId}, #{bizDeptId}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{urgency}, #{title}, #{content}, #{location}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{imageUrls}, #{accessTokenHash}, #{submitIp}, #{submitUa}, #{dueTime}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_ticket WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM service_ticket WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM service_ticket
ORDER BY status ASC, due_time ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE service_ticket SET status = #{toStatus}, assignee_id = COALESCE(#{assigneeId}, assignee_id), assignee_name = COALESCE(#{assigneeName}, assignee_name), accept_time = COALESCE(accept_time, #{acceptTime}), done_time = COALESCE(#{doneTime}, done_time), close_time = COALESCE(#{closeTime}, close_time) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN #{es}
UPDATE service_ticket SET done_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM service_ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 20 AND COALESCE(done_time, update_time) <= #{deadline} ORDER BY COALESCE(done_time, update_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE service_ticket SET rating = #{rating}, rating_comment = #{ratingComment} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND rating IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM service_ticket WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()
